_comment: Hardcoded-copy lint (#1724): scripts/i18n-hardcoded.mjs, run by scripts/i18n-check.mjs in CI.

It parses frontend/src/**/*.tsx and mobile/{app,components,hooks}/**/*.tsx and reports user-facing string literals that do not go through t(): JSX text, the props placeholder/title/aria-label/alt/accessibilityLabel/accessibilityHint/label, JSX child expressions, and the arguments of error setters and Alert.alert.

allow: exact strings (after whitespace is collapsed) that are the same in every language, each with the reason. Reviewed like code: a brand name, a format mask or a wire token belongs here; a sentence never does. An entry that matches nothing fails the check.
ignore_files: whole files that never reach a user (dev-only screens), each with the reason. A path that is not a scanned file fails the check.

baseline: the ratchet. Violations that existed when the lint landed, as { file: { text: count } }. A violation not covered here fails; so does an entry that no longer occurs. After fixing one, shrink it with `node scripts/i18n-hardcoded.mjs --update-baseline`. Never grow it by hand to get a new string past the check: put the string in a catalogue.

allow.Pollis: Brand name, the same in every language (the desktop title bar).
allow.A3-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX: Format mask of the Secret Key, which is the same Latin-alphabet string in every locale.
allow.pollis-link:v2:…: Format of a device-link code (a wire value the user pastes), shown as the input's placeholder.
allow.@all: The mention token itself, typed literally in every language; its description next to it is translated.
allow./g/: A group's URL path (/g/<slug>), an identifier rather than prose.
allow.v{…}: Version-number prefix (v1.2.3) under the mobile launch screen; numbers and the v are not translated anywhere in the app.

ignore_files.mobile/app/dev/client-policy.tsx: Dev-build-only screen (pollis://dev/client-policy) for overriding the client policy; never reachable in a store build.
